requiredScope: The fixed grammar, profile and complete-model obligations remain in force.

From/Join.role: A binary FULL join and the ordered equality predicate of its merged int4 keys.
From/Join.structure: Two ordered ordinary input occurrences and a pruned Boolean equality tree.
From/Join.conditions: All USING or NATURAL merge keys resolve exactly once in both inputs and have the native built-in int4 type and equality operator. A direct FULL condition is a nonempty conjunction of opposite-side field equalities or the constant TRUE. Input and expression budgets are checked before publication.
From/Join.meaning: Keep matched pairs with all key equalities true and separately keep each unmatched occurrence row with the other side extended with NULL. A disjoint NATURAL merge starts with a true condition.
From/Join.sql: Emit FULL JOIN with OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) scoped to the physical inputs of each equality, or ON TRUE for a disjoint NATURAL join.

Expression/IntegerCase.role: The scalar of a merged int4 output in a FULL join.
Expression/IntegerCase.structure: One searched CASE arm testing the physical left field for IS NOT NULL, the same left field as its result, and the physical right field as ELSE.
Expression/IntegerCase.conditions: Both references use their own checked occurrence and column positions. Qualified original fields still resolve to their own physical occurrences.
Expression/IntegerCase.meaning: Return the left integer when it is present, and otherwise return the right integer or NULL. Matched integer keys agree by the equality predicate.
Expression/IntegerCase.sql: Emit the existing typed CASE expression under the exact merged heading.

externalInterpretation: Both observations use the same PostgreSQL int4 declarations, inherited rows and database fixtures.
observations: Result ordinals, names, int4 metadata and typed NULL
Matched duplicates and each unmatched side including NULL keys
Declared/NATURAL versus explicit USING order and merged alias
Distinct physical values alongside the synthesized merged field
Empty and populated disjoint input and occurrence-local ONLY

finite.completeness: Compare exact native metadata and typed row bags for every actual product identity, requiring each once. The physical projection puts the second occurrence first so it stays distinguishable even for a disjoint join.

exploration.requiredForms: Vary key order, operand direction, conjunction association, physical and merged expressions, repeated slots, empty and populated sources and ONLY flags.

analysis: A FULL USING (id) publishes a two-origin merged int4 value.
A reversed two-key USING list preserves the written output ordering.
A NATURAL FULL join uses the left declaration ordering.
A FULL USING alias exposes the merged keys beside both physical fields.
A qualified wildcard reads both original headings with NULL extension.
Disjoint NATURAL FULL with an empty right input retains the left.
Disjoint NATURAL FULL with a filled right input evaluates the product.
ONLY on a merged FULL scan suppresses child rows on that occurrence.
negative: A FULL condition admits OR in place of a conjunction.
A conjunction term reads two fields of the same side.
A FALSE condition has no role in this registered domain.
A merged result refers to a nonexistent slot.
A FULL merge consumes a non-int4 key.
faults: Use the left field in both branches of the merged CASE.
Remove the first projected merge field.

evidence.P01: Check both origins and the operation that chooses the merged int4 value.
evidence.P02: Reject inadmissible predicate trees, key types and references at their owner.
evidence.P03: Publish only explicit typed CASE and join values with immutable resolved slots.
evidence.P04: Independently pair retained rows and evaluate the ordered scalar arms.
evidence.P05: Use the static closure of the registered immutable join, CASE and slot roles.
evidence.P06: Compare both original and emitted SQL to the reference evaluator.
evidence.Q01: Check condition and scope code shapes and typed boundary refusals.
evidence.Q02: Demand both releases and all actual finite, seed and analyzed identities.
evidence.Q03: Check the checked conjunction and two-origin scalar as coupled but separable roles.
evidence.Q04: Compare int4 output names/types and every retained row against each native engine.
evidence.Q05: Record exact distributions, source patches, runtimes and archived comparator digests.

open: Full merged fields in consumers with a physical-only operand role require further admission rules and evidence.
Non-int4 keys, joins over merged prefixes and whole-join aliases remain open.
